Module de.learnlib.api
Package de.learnlib.statistic

Class StatisticsKey

java.lang.Object
de.learnlib.statistic.StatisticsKey
public final class StatisticsKey extends Object
A key to be used when interacting with StatisticsServices. Conceptionally, a StatisticsKey consists of a base key and an optional id to denote hierarchical relationships. StatisticsKeys can be enhanced with (optional) descriptions for displaying purposes. However, the descriptions are not part of a keys identity.

    • isSubkeyOf

      public boolean isSubkeyOf(StatisticsKey that)
      Returns whether this key is a subkey of the given one. A subkey relationship holds iff both base keys are equal and this key's id is either undefined to equal to the given key's id.
      Parameters:
      that - the other key to compare to
      Returns:
      true if this is a subkey of the provided one, false otherwise
